items.t: Primaquine, oral, 0.25 mg base/kg/day for 14 days (obtained using section 21 approval). · Continue chloroquine once weekly until primaquine is obtained.

cautions.t: Test for G6PD before radical-cure courses

adverse_effects.t: Haemolysis in G6PD deficiency, methaemoglobinaemia, abdominal cramps
